title: Design System: Agwood Mill & Lumber — Slow Grown

paper.purpose: The page ground. A warm dry paper, not cream and not white.

paper-deep.purpose: Alternate section ground. The only surface change on the site.

grain.purpose: Every drawn grain line and band. Never carries text.

forest.purpose: THE ACTION COLOUR. Measured from the logo's fill green.

forest-deep.purpose: Footer ground. The logo's own outline ink.

russet.purpose: THE STATE COLOUR. You-are-here, current, active.

display.purpose: The one hero line per page. Fraunces 500 at opsz 144, SOFT 0, WONK 0 — the wobble switched off so it reads as an engraved plate face, not a playful one.

title.purpose: The wordmark beside the emblem, and sub-heads. Fraunces 600 at opsz 40.

lede.purpose: The dim paragraph under a display line. Archivo 400.

body.purpose: Running prose and spec rows. Archivo 400.

label.purpose: Section eyebrows and the sticker labels on drawn slots. Archivo 700, wide tracking, uppercase. NOT monospace — see the Don'ts.

control.purpose: The action button and nav links. Archivo 700.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: There are no shadows in this world. Depth comes from ground tone and drawn grain density; a drop shadow would make a plate look like a card. See the Don'ts.

motion.name: ease-surface
motion.purpose: The vault surfacing and every scroll reveal.

motion.name: surface
motion.purpose: The vault reveals bottom-up, the way grain appears as a board is planed. The crown of the arch completes last. Runs once, never repeats.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Single column; vault shortens to 210px and crops its sides rather than squashing.

components.name: Action Button
components.description: The single primary action: email the mill. Forest fill, paper text, square. Green appears nowhere else except inline links and focus rings.

components.name: The Vault
components.description: SIGNATURE. The cathedral figure of a flatsawn redwood board, drawn as filled latewood bands and generated at build time. Nested arches at the centre relaxing continuously into vertical grain at the edges. Used ONCE per site, on Home. Surfaces bottom-up on load.

components.name: Grain Band
components.description: SIGNATURE. Replaces every hairline rule on the site. A band of drawn vertical grain whose line density encodes the weight of the section beneath it — rings per inch is the trade's own quality measure, so density is information here, not texture.

components.name: Drawn Slot
components.description: SIGNATURE. The declared placeholder, built from the design's own material. A missing photograph is a framed panel of drawn redwood naming what belongs there. Never a grey box, never dashed scaffolding, never stock photography.

components.name: Spec Row
components.description: The what-we-run and contact tables. Label left in ink, value right in dim ink. An unknown value is set in russet and says what to do instead of pretending to be data.

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Dim ink at rest; RUSSET when it is the current page. Never green — green means you can do something, and being somewhere is not doing something.

narrative.overview: Tight grain costs more log to get. Cut radially and you take fewer boards from the same tree, so the grain on a board is the physical record of what the mill gave up to produce it. The site is built from drawn wood — generated geometry, never photography — because Agwood owns no pictures of itself and the trade draws grain rather than photographing it.
keyCharacteristics: Grain is drawn, not photographed. Every line is generated at build time.
A growth ring is a band with width, not a hairline. Filled latewood bands are what read as wood.
Rings per inch is the trade's quality measure, so line density carries hierarchy.
Green acts, russet locates. They never cross.
No shadows, no rounded corners, no monospace.
Every unknown ships as a declared slot in the design's own material.
rules: The Vault appears exactly once per site.
Green is only ever on something you can do.
Russet is only ever on where you are.
A missing fact is drawn, labelled, and never guessed.
No sustainability or certification claim without a certificate in hand.
openItems: The client approved the Vault to proceed but is not sold on it: 'still not in love with your rendition of the arches though but im done fighting it. lets see how it looks after full execution.' Reviewed again after Phase 3. Do not treat as settled.
